authorization.note: pre-registration and notebook hypothesis entry only; no fit, no replay, no orders until supervisor review

objective: test whether matching the prediction horizon AND the real holding horizon to 20 trading days (H20) produces a stable net-of-fee excess over SOXX with controlled drawdown, holding everything else identical to the H5 reference

single_mechanism.hypothesis: matched horizon 20 sessions (prediction = holding = 20) is one testable methodological increment over the registered H5 single point
single_mechanism.confound: relative to H5 this changes BOTH label information and execution frequency; no result may be attributed to fees alone

causal_timing_contract.model_training_maturity: label_h20_available_at(signal) < year_cutoff (mature labels only; outer years evaluation only)
causal_timing_contract.label_h20_available_at: open of the real D.calendar t+21 session at 09:31 America/New_York (NOT a natural-day +1)
causal_timing_contract.allocation_decision_at: after the next-open pretrade quote is captured (>= next session open 09:31 America/New_York); the solve/order consumes next-open pretrade quantities/weights, so it must NOT be labeled prior-day 16:15
causal_timing_contract.sigma_estimation: estimated from known previous close (information available at prediction_at)
causal_timing_contract.sigma_constraint_evaluated_at: the actual open target (allocation_decision_at pretrade state)
causal_timing_contract.variance_constraint_time: must equal allocation_decision_at (no 16:15 vs next-open mismatch)
causal_timing_contract.historical_open_9_30: explicit proxy only; future-open pretrade information must never be stamped as prior-day 16:15
causal_timing_contract.paper_fill: captured live quote at execution; no historical-open fill assumption

units.note: mu20 is a simple return, NOT squared; do not mix the three units

source_binding.provider_manifest_limitation: the two manifest files are byte-identical templates; identity is bound by provider_content_sha256 instead
source_binding.no_source17: the stage1_economic_action 17f81fbf prepared_inputs (uniform ~2690) is NOT used to generate training features; no pricing-vintage change is mixed in
source_binding.provider_content_hash_scope: Reproducible via src.data.provider_content_hash.provider_content_hash(store); exact serialization and per-file inventory in provider_content_hash_scope.json (sidecar). No provider was modified.

selection_protocol.rule: same mature-year purged validation selection as purged_ridge_regularization_20261009; scaler fit inside inner train; selection by prior-year strictly-mature validation error; outer year evaluation only; no outer-year use in selection
selection_protocol.no_frozen_alternative: the earlier optional frozen-model fallback is removed
selection_protocol.not_an_alpha_grid: these 4 candidates are the registered protocol, not a new hyperparameter search

horizon.budget: one H20 candidate; H5 is the existing reference; no H63, no other horizons, no horizon tuning
horizon.h5_dataset_untouched: convex default HORIZON_SESSIONS=5 and the H5 workflow stay as they are

h5_reference.label: benchmark_terminal_H5
h5_reference.objective_accounting: same benchmark-terminal objective and daily-risk accounting as this H5 reference
h5_reference.no_mixing: must not simultaneously use the original terminal-value H5 and a benchmark-terminal H20 (that would confound the objective)
h5_reference.causal_audit_required: audit the H5 reference pretrade dependency/clock; if causally invalid, mark invalid, do not relabel old results

maturity.h5_parent_note: 2692 is the H5 parent sample count only
maturity.h20_mature_rule: must be computed from the real prices/calendar and the evaluation cutoff for H20, never copied from the H5 count

gates.numerical_floor_scope: Only positive-effect classification changes; all raw returns, point estimates and CI values retained. Cumulative aggregate, each annual, leave-one-year and rolling log excess must exceed 1e-8; bootstrap uses N*daily_lower > 1e-8. Pure-SOXX floating noise never qualifies as alpha.
gates.gate_definition: All existing complete 2016-2022 SOXX net return/year/rolling/MaxDD/CVaR/bootstrap gates at both costs retained; numerical floor only tightens zero comparison. Raw old sign and qualified counts both reported. No production from reused history.

checked_numerically_at_both_costs.block_bootstrap_lower_gt_0: blocks 20 and 60; bootstrap_resamples 2000; family_size 1; lower bound > 0

gates.result_must_be_computed: the gate result is computed from the H20 run; it is not pre-set

fail_stop.rule: if dev or outer net-of-fee rel SOXX <= 1, or MaxDD/CVaR/annual gates fail, or historical gate False -> not_promoted / end_h20_route_no_further_search
fail_stop.no_retry: no H change, no parameter re-search
fail_stop.promotion_requires: new freeze + independent paper qualification (>= 60 sessions, original 10/25bp) after any historical pass; old paper is NOT transferred as forward evidence

core_capability.approach: make horizon a generic parameter with default 5 and add focused compatibility tests; do NOT copy the whole H5 constant into a parallel 20-framework
core_capability.legacy_workflows: existing dedicated H5 workflows keep taking 5 only and their sealed results stay untouched

constraints: 0 fit / 0 new strategy / 0 orders until authorization
do not modify sealed cards, data, or production
technical_timestamp_correction: Earlier draft carried a placeholder 00:00 timestamp. Replaced with the real current UTC draft time; this corrects a technical field only and does not claim the experiment was frozen earlier than now.

source_compatibility_audit_only.issue: the H5 legacy reference decides at signal-day 16:15 while next-open execution reads pretrade state; recorded as a source-compatibility audit item
source_compatibility_audit_only.action: audit only; do not modify the sealed parent and do not relabel old results to make them pass
source_compatibility_audit_only.h20_contract: H20 allocation quote captured after next open 09:31 NY; Sigma estimated from known previous close may be reused
